instruction: I've drafted an email reminder for those who haven't paid tuition. Please check the payment record and add the emails of the first three students with unpaid status (Fox, Iron, Nancy) to the receiver field.

metadata.explanation: Task requires reading tuition_payment.xlsx to identify first three students who haven't paid (Payment='No'), then adding their email addresses to the To field in Thunderbird. Verified with Python: Fox (row 7), Iron (row 10), and Nancy (row 15) are the first three unpaid students. Evaluator checks for their presence in the To field using accessibility tree selectors. Uses existing check_accessibility_tree metric.
metadata.verification_details: Processed complete Excel file (27 rows): First 3 unpaid students in order are Fox, Iron, Nancy. All 4 unpaid students verified: fox@someuniversity.edu, iron@someuniversity.edu, nancy@someuniversity.edu, stella@someuniversity.edu.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly uses accessibility tree to verify UI state in Thunderbird compose window
All three required email addresses (Fox, Iron, Nancy) are verified in the To field
CSS selectors are well-formed and target the correct UI elements (MsgHeadersToolbar > To field > address pills)
Complete coverage: instruction requires adding three specific emails to To field, evaluator checks all three
Getter (get_accessibility_tree) extracts the correct state needed for verification
Metric (check_accessibility_tree) correctly compares accessibility tree elements against expected selectors
Postconfig includes 10-second sleep for UI stabilization, which is appropriate
Expected values semantically match the instruction requirements (first three unpaid students)
